# SOP-P1-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03  
Related: ECN-2026-043, MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1, SB-1026

1. Purpose and scope  
This procedure defines the required steps for product changeover on the machining line P1-L3. It covers setup, verification, and handover for EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03. It ensures consistent thermal, clamping, and machining conditions and documents records to maintain traceability during changeover.

2. Background and rationale  
Changeovers on the machining line directly affect part geometry, metallurgical condition, and tool life. Proper control of billet temperature, chuck clamping, and headstock setup reduces rework and rejects. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. These values are mandatory setpoints established by engineering (see ECN-2026-043) and maintenance standards (see MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1). SB-1026 provides safety boundaries for thermal handling; follow it for material handling steps.

3. Preconditions (must be met before starting)  
3.1 Operator and maintenance personnel briefed on changeover scope and associated engineering change ECN-2026-043.  
3.2 Required spares and fixtures staged at the line and verified against MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.  
3.3 All affected equipment cleared of previous production material and safe to access per SB-1026.  
3.4 All control interlocks in service; emergency stop function verified. (Refer to SB-1026 for verification method.)

4. PPE (minimum required)  
4.1 Heat-resistant gloves and face shield for billet transfer and induction heater access per SB-1026.  
4.2 Mechanical gloves and eye protection for tooling changes and chuck access.  
4.3 Hearing protection when inside the active machining area.  
4.4 Arc-rated clothing if performing live-weld or brazing tasks on fixtures (refer to SB-1026).

5. Materials and references to use during changeover  
5.1 Production order and setup sheet from ECN-2026-043.  
5.2 Machine setup checklist MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 for EQ-P1-L3-CN03.  
5.3 Safety bulletin SB-1026 for thermal and mechanical hazard controls.  
5.4 Calibration records for torque tool used for chuck jaw bolts.

6. Procedure — numbered operational steps

6.1 Prepare and isolate  
6.1.1 Verify preconditions in section 3. Ensure line power and controls are in the required state per SB-1026.  
6.1.2 Lockout-tagout only if tools or fixtures require maintenance; otherwise follow live setup steps allowed by ECN-2026-043.

6.2 Induction heater setup (EQ-P1-L3-IH01)  
6.2.1 Confirm heater control software recipe matches ECN-2026-043.  
6.2.2 Load billet stock and position within heater chamber per operator guidance.  
6.2.3 Set and confirm target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. Record actual readback on the changeover log. Rationale: consistent billet temperature ensures predictable machining behavior and metallurgical properties. Example record entry: "IH01 target: 1235 °C, readback: [value shown on heater]."

6.3 Handling and transfer to headstock (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)  
6.3.1 Use specified lifting fixtures and follow SB-1026 for thermal handling.  
6.3.2 Confirm alignment and seating of billet in the headstock; document any corrective actions taken. Rationale: misalignment causes eccentric machining and premature tool wear.

6.4 Lathe/chuck preparation (EQ-P1-L3-CN03)  
6.4.1 Inspect chuck and jaws for wear and cleanliness. Refer to MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 for jaw selection.  
6.4.2 Install appropriate jaws and clamp sample billet. Torque chuck jaw bolts to the specified value: The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and record the serial number of the wrench and the torque applied. Rationale: correct bolt torque secures jaws, prevents slippage, and avoids distortion of the fixture. Example record: "CN03 jaw bolts torqued to 95 N·m, torque tool SN: [calibration tag]."

6.5 Tooling and program load  
6.5.1 Verify tooling pockets and offsets match the production program from ECN-2026-043.  
6.5.2 Load program and perform dry cycle without material if required by MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1. Observe axes motion and run a stationary verification per the checklist.

6.6 First-piece verification and measurement  
6.6.1 Machine first-piece and measure critical dimensions per ECN-2026-043. Record measurements on the changeover record. Rationale: first-piece checks confirm setup validity and avoid batch-wide errors. Example record fields: "dimension, nominal, measured, disposition."

6.7 Adjustment and stabilization  
6.7.1 If measurements are out of tolerance, adjust offsets or fixturing and repeat first-piece verification. Document all adjustments and reason codes. Rationale: traceability required for process audits.

6.8 Documentation and records to keep  
6.8.1 Changeover log: include operator names, start and completion checkpoints, and signatures.  
6.8.2 Thermal log for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 showing target and readback of 1235 °C.  
6.8.3 Torque record for EQ-P1-L3-CN03 showing 95 N·m and torque tool identification.  
6.8.4 First-piece inspection sheet and disposition notes referenced to ECN-2026-043.  
6.8.5 Attach any deviation or NCRs and reference SB-1026 when safety deviations occur.

7. Completion and handover  
7.1 Confirm all records are completed and attached to the production order.  
7.2 Notify production control that the line is ready for production and that verification steps and records conform to ECN-2026-043 and MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.  
7.3 If safety bulletins in SB-1026 required containment or signage, verify removal or continued display as appropriate.

8. Sign-off (required)  
Operator: ____________________  Date: ____________________  
Maintenance: __________________  Date: ____________________  
Line Lead: ____________________  Date: ____________________  

9. Revision control and notes  
Refer to ECN-2026-043 for engineering changes, MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 for machine-specific setup steps, and SB-1026 for safety procedures. Preserve the signed changeover records in the document control system per plant retention policy.
